method.cache_hit: DatasetCache(max_entries=1) primed outside timing; every hit reads and hashes source bytes
method.discard: after complete artifact, workload and parity validation, only token-owned results/<job_id>.json files are unlinked; manifests, indexes, hashes, observations and child reports remain
method.economic_digest: complete economic result per configuration, excluding only dataset lineage; non-experiment rows reference the verified baseline workload after bar identity verification
method.experiment: load, identity-bound job construction, complete sequential simulation, detailed export and finalization; independent artifact verification excluded
method.first_process_read: child import/setup separately; parent before Popen through child exit includes interpreter, imports, read, verification and report
method.memory: resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss normalized to bytes; lifetime own-process high water includes earlier work; parent and child reported separately, never summed
method.order: rotate layouts each repetition; six operations per layout
method.pickle: protocol 5 in-band dumps and loads timed separately; verification excluded; end-to-end includes both and verification
method.read_timing: load_dataset includes file snapshot, hashing, parsing and internal validation; independent harness verification excluded
method.transfer: same-host multiprocessing spawn, pre-serialized protocol-5 payload over Pipe; transfer through decode ACK excludes independent child verification by handshake; end-to-end through verified child exit
method.warm_read: same interpreter, no DatasetCache; already exercised layout, OS cache uncontrolled
